annotations.title: List IAM Identity Center accounts and roles

description: List the AWS accounts and roles an IAM Identity Center login can use, after aws_login_start + aws_login_complete with ssoSession. Read-only. Each role shows `profile`: the existing config profile that already points at it (generated or hand-written), or null. Per-account failures come back as `rolesError` while the other accounts still list. If the token is missing or expired the error says to run aws_login_start with ssoSession again. Follow with aws_sso_generate_profiles to write profiles.

accountIds.description: Only these 12-digit account IDs. Default: every assigned account.

includeRoles.description: Default true. false returns accounts only (one AWS call).

ssoSession.description: sso-session name logged in via aws_login_start.

name: aws_sso_list_assignments
